_readme: Generated from the DetectMate benchmark runs by an export script; do not edit by hand, rerun the export. log_types: the log types, each with the range of its datasets' anomaly shares in percent. datasets: the evaluated datasets, each with its log type, source and the anomaly share of its evaluated lines in percent. not_evaluated: detectors without results. baselines: the deep-learning detectors DetectMate is compared with. results: per detector and dataset, precision, recall, F1 and detection events per second, measured on the hardware named in environment. log_type_results: the same per log type, the mean over its datasets (precision over the datasets with alerts). Where a detector raised no alerts, precision is null and no_alerts is true.

environment.hardware: OVH c3-16: 8 vCPU AMD EPYC Milan, 15 GB; one run at a time; CPU only
